name: [🌀] Ability Slap Tower 1✋
desc:
Welcome to the Ability Slap Tower 1 ✋!
Can you climb this troll tower without getting slapped down? 🤔
Reach 1000 wins 🏆 to unlock the powerful Infinity Glove 🌌.

🌀 Extra 🌀
🔐 Find the secret code in this troll obby to unlock the Silver Glove 🌟.
🚀 The Big Glove ✋ increases your attack range.
🛡️ Buy checkpoints to save your progress by collecting Slaps.
👥 Get 1 win for every friend who plays for at least 5 minutes! 🎁

👍 Like the game and join the group 👥 for free tools!

📍 Inspired by Slap Battles, with surprises, troll traps, and chaotic fun along the way.
Are you ready to dominate the tower - or will you be dragged all the way down?
(Credits: @rkdss for the standard glove template.)
